title: MT69008: Phase Transformation Lab.
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

1.Experimental determination of a binary phase diagram2.Solidification
macro/microstructure of some single phase and eutectic alloys3.Solidification
Macrostructure of Cast Metals4.Microstructure of eutectic systems5.Study of the
Solidification History in Welded Microstructure of Steels6.Study of pearlite
transformation in eutectoid steel using DSC / DTA and determination of TTT
diagram7.Cold rolling and recrystallisation annealing8.Study of crystallization
of in an amorphous material9.Martensite transformation in Fe-Ni alloy to study
the shape deformation
